end.line: Quillon for Calder Mines’ legal team

vo: Calder Mines’ twelve lawyers support forty operating sites, with offtake and royalty contracts spread across three systems.
In the vault, Quillon reviews every agreement at once: four hundred and twelve documents in nine minutes, one clause per column.
Ask one question across the whole matter, and Quillon reads every agreement in the vault before it answers.
For the board’s quarterly summary, Quillon orders every notice by date, each event cited to its exhibit.
Tom will walk your team through it on Monday the ninth.
